name: The Girl in Yellow
source:
You're a journalist investigating the disappearance of the "Girl in Yellow." The trail leads you to an infamous phone booth, where victims reportedly vanished. Now, you must piece together the truth by dialling the correct numbers. 

[From [url=https://midnighteclipsy.itch.io/thegirlinyellow]itch.io[/url]]
